blogs.title: How to Prepare for TNPSC Group 4 with a Clear Study Plan
blogs.shortDescription: A practical preparation rhythm for Group 4 aspirants: syllabus, revision, tests and current affairs.
blogs.content: TNPSC Group 4 preparation becomes easier when students follow a weekly structure. Start with the syllabus, revise Tamil and General Studies regularly, practise aptitude every day and review mock-test mistakes. PAART Academy keeps the process focused with study materials, current affairs support and guided tests.

blogs.title: Why Daily Current Affairs Matter for TNPSC Exams
blogs.shortDescription: A daily reading habit helps students connect events with exam-relevant facts and concepts.
blogs.content: Current affairs preparation works best when it is consistent. Read short daily notes, connect them with static subjects and revise monthly. This habit improves recall and makes mock tests more meaningful.
